classification: temporal-extension validation of the frozen R343 portfolio on the earliest common C-sleeve window
hypothesis: The frozen R343 construction retains positive return, drawdown control, cost resilience and concentration breadth when the sample is extended backward to 2022-05-05, before the 2023-05-04 selection window.
disclosure: R340-R343 all inherited a 2023-05-04 start from the R339 C-sleeve screen. R344's coverage-only preflight found the first eligible C candidates on 2022-05-05: 39 candidates, 286 non-null ROE/debt observations and 270 non-null OCF/NI observations that day. No return or backtest metric was inspected before freezing this preregistration. The added 2022-05-05..2023-05-03 period is prior to the R343 selection window and is a quasi-out-of-sample temporal extension, not a fully independent out-of-sample test.

window.start_basis: first date with at least 10 eligible C candidates under basic filter, current HS300 membership and all required factor inputs

fixed_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity across A/B/C with original [0.20,0.60] bounds; then cap C at 10% and redistribute excess proportionally to A/B
fixed_construction.defensive_bucket: gold 200-day trend proxy / 511260.SH / 510880.SH equal 1/3 monthly; when gold is OFF, its third is replaced by 50% 511260.SH plus 50% 510880.SH
fixed_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage

data.D1_preflight: coverage-only preflight passed with all checks true before returns were evaluated
data.D2_curves: all A/B/C curves start on 2022-05-05 and extend through 2026-11-05
data.D3_input_isolation: production and R40 research input trees remain byte-hash stable

absolute_performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

robustness.R2_gold: 159937.SZ replacement through the same proxy annual >=5%, MDD >= -20%, 2024/2025 >=0
robustness.F1_fresh: at least 5/6 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 5/6 fresh starts positive
satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates and P4 must pass. Otherwise record the extension as negative and do not promote. No threshold changes after results.
discipline: Use the exact R343 A/B/C construction; no score, holding period, stop-loss, cap, overlay, asset or weight change.
The 200-day gold rule is not scanned again.
The extended start is selected only from the pre-return coverage audit.
No leverage; no paper target or order file.
known_limitations: The extension is quasi-out-of-sample, not independent: earlier factor research may have observed the same market history.
The common window begins in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier; it is not a 2018-2026 test.
The gold trend rule, 10% C cap and broad C sleeve are post-hoc choices.
Current-snapshot industry classification, reconstructed membership and ETF qfq caches are not full vendor PIT data.
The proxy does not model intraday execution or ETF premium/discount.
